process.title: In-Home Consult
process.desc: We analyze your existing layout, listen closely to your space frustrations, clarify your aesthetic goals, and define initial parameters.

process.title: Design & Selection
process.desc: Our design team creates visual space renderings, helping you coordinate cabinetry styles, countertop slabs, hardware, and premium finishes.

process.title: Precision Build
process.desc: With continuous partner supervision, our specialized master craftsmen manage framing, plumbing, high-grade carpentry, and surface installations.

process.title: Walkthrough & Delivery
process.desc: We meticulously review every single detail with you, validating smooth drawer runners, flawless tile joints, and general space excellence.

whyUs.title: Three Generations of Legacy
whyUs.desc: Our family name stands on decades of honest construction experience, reliable business practices, and hard-earned expertise.

whyUs.title: Cabinet Shop

whyUs.title: True Turnkey Ownership
whyUs.desc: No subcontractor scheduling confusion. We handle everything from permits and wiring maps to the final coat of protective paint.

testimonial.quote: After talking with several designers and remodeling contractors, we decided on Ferrentino & Son. They got what we wanted straight away and had plans done in less than a week. The best part is how the kitchen actually turned out. Amazing, simply amazing!
testimonial.author: John & Trisha D.

items.title: Kitchen Remodeling
items.description: Create a kitchen that combines functionality, comfort, and style. We remodel it to make cooking, gathering, storing, and everyday life feel easier, while giving the space a look that feels completely at home.
items.detailHeroDesc: Transform the heart of your home into a culinary sanctuary. Tailored architectural layouts, custom cabinetry fabrication, and high-end finishes.
items.introTitle: Making the Most of Your Kitchen
introParagraphs: A successful kitchen remodel balances elegant aesthetic presentation with deep functional utility. At Ferrentino & Son, we believe your kitchen should be tailored to your culinary habits, hosting preferences, and storage needs.

Our team takes complete ownership of your project, from initial structural layout drafts and electrical mapping to bespoke cabinetry fabrication, high-tier appliance integration, and stone countertop installation.
introChecklist: Luxurious natural stone and quartz countertop slabs
Integrated ambient and task-focused layered lighting designs

featured.title: The Ocala Modern Manor
featured.desc: Featuring hand-selected materials, full custom architectural integrations, and custom spatial optimizations. Built to last generations.

featured.title: Southern Heritage Estate
featured.desc: Featuring hand-selected materials, full custom architectural integrations, and custom spatial optimizations. Built to last generations.

faqs.question: How long does a typical kitchen remodeling project take?
faqs.answer: A comprehensive kitchen remodel generally takes between 4 to 8 weeks depending on structural layout changes, plumbing rerouting, and custom-cabinet requirements.

faqs.question: Can I remain in my home during the kitchen remodel?
faqs.answer: Yes, though the kitchen workspace will be fully isolated to minimize dust. We set up temporary cooking solutions and construct safety dust walls to preserve your daily home comfort.

faqs.question: Do you build the cabinetry in-house?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team fabricates bespoke hardwood cabinets specifically engineered to your kitchen layout parameters at our local cabinet shop, guaranteeing a perfect fit.

faqs.question: Do you assist in choosing high-end appliances?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We help coordinate dimensions, custom panel requirements for integrated styles, and electrical configurations with top premium appliance suppliers.

items.title: Bathroom Remodeling
items.description: Small room, big impact. We rework bathrooms with better layouts, smarter storage, updated finishes, and details that make the space feel noticeably better every day.
items.detailHeroDesc: Turn a tired bathroom into a private retreat with smarter layouts, spa-grade fixtures, and finishes built to last.
items.introTitle: Making the Most of Your Bathroom
introParagraphs: Bathrooms are small rooms with outsized impact on daily life. We focus on layout efficiency, storage, and finishes that hold up to daily moisture and use.
From zero-threshold showers to heated floors and custom vanities, we manage every trade in-house so the project moves on schedule.
introChecklist: Natural stone and porcelain slab surfaces

featured.title: Lake Weir Spa Sanctuary
featured.desc: A bespoke master bath remodel with a curbless rain shower and natural stone masonry.

featured.title: Downtown Guest Bath Refresh
featured.desc: A compact guest bath reimagined with smarter storage and durable, elegant finishes.

faqs.question: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
faqs.answer: Most full bathroom remodels take 3 to 6 weeks depending on plumbing changes and material lead times.

faqs.question: Can you add a walk-in or zero-threshold shower?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly convert tub/shower combos into curbless walk-in showers, including any required framing and drainage changes.

faqs.question: Will you handle plumbing and electrical?
faqs.answer: Yes, all plumbing and electrical work is coordinated in-house through our licensed trade partners.

faqs.question: What finish options do you offer?
faqs.answer: We source natural stone, porcelain slab, and tile finishes, and help you select options that fit your budget and style.

items.title: Home Remodeling
items.description: Sometimes a home just needs to work differently. We rethink outdated spaces, awkward layouts, and tired finishes to create a home that fits the way you live now.
items.detailHeroDesc: Rethink outdated layouts and tired finishes with a whole-home remodel built around how you actually live.
items.introTitle: A Home That Works The Way You Live
introParagraphs: Many homes just need to work differently: opened-up living areas, better flow between rooms, and finishes that match how the family actually uses the space.
We coordinate structural, electrical, and finish work as one project, so your remodel moves through design and construction without disconnected subcontractors.
introChecklist: Single point of contact from design to delivery

featured.title: Ocala Oak-Wood Remodel
featured.desc: A whole-home remodel highlighting custom cabinetry, vaulted ceilings, and meticulous hardwood finishings.

featured.title: Open-Concept Living Refresh
featured.desc: Reopened sightlines and raised ceilings brought light and scale into the main living space.

faqs.question: Can I remodel in phases?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can plan whole-home remodels in phases to match your budget and timeline.

faqs.question: Do you handle structural changes?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team handles load-bearing wall removal, header installation, and any required permitting and engineering.

faqs.question: How do you keep the project on schedule?
faqs.answer: We manage every trade in-house under one schedule instead of coordinating separate subcontractors.

faqs.question: Can I live in the home during the remodel?
faqs.answer: In most cases yes, with dust barriers and phased work areas to minimize disruption.

items.title: Home Renovations
items.description: Keep the character. Change what's not working. Our renovation work brings older or dated spaces forward while respecting the home that was already there.
items.detailHeroDesc: We bring older, dated spaces forward while preserving the architectural character that made the home special.
items.introTitle: Keep The Character, Fix What's Not Working
introParagraphs: Older homes carry character that's worth preserving, but systems and layouts can fall behind how a family lives today.
Our renovation work updates electrical, plumbing, insulation, and layout while respecting original architectural detail wherever possible.

featured.title: Historic Downtown Ocala Loft
featured.desc: A comprehensive restoration of a historic commercial building into modern executive suites.

featured.title: Character Home Refresh
featured.desc: Updated systems and finishes while preserving original trim and architectural detail.

faqs.question: Will renovation preserve the original character of my home?
faqs.answer: Yes, preserving character is central to our renovation approach; we restore and match original detail wherever possible.

faqs.question: Do you handle older homes with outdated systems?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly update electrical, plumbing, and insulation in older homes as part of a renovation.

faqs.question: How do you handle unexpected issues behind the walls?
faqs.answer: We build contingency into the schedule and budget and communicate any findings with you before proceeding.

faqs.question: Can you match existing trim and millwork?
faqs.answer: Yes, our cabinet shop can reproduce or match existing trim, casing, and millwork profiles.

items.title: Home Additions
items.description: Need more room? Expand your living space with a thoughtfully designed addition that complements your existing home.
items.detailHeroDesc: Expand your living space with an addition engineered and finished to match your existing home.
introParagraphs: A great addition should feel like it was always part of the house, matching rooflines, siding, and finish detail on the exterior and interior alike.
We handle structural tie-ins, foundation work, and permitting so your new square footage integrates cleanly with the existing structure.
introChecklist: Matched rooflines, siding, and exterior finishes
Interior finish matching to existing home

featured.title: Equestrian Pavilion Addition
featured.desc: A commercial-grade covered addition engineered with long-span timber trusses.

featured.title: Master Suite Addition
featured.desc: A seamlessly integrated master suite addition with matched architectural detail.

faqs.question: Will my addition match the rest of my home?
faqs.answer: Yes, we match rooflines, siding, and interior finishes so the addition reads as part of the original home.

faqs.question: Do you handle permits and engineering?
faqs.answer: Yes, we manage structural engineering, permitting, and inspections for every addition.

faqs.question: How long does a typical addition take?
faqs.answer: Most additions take 3 to 6 months depending on size, foundation type, and permitting timelines.

faqs.question: Can you add a second story?
faqs.answer: Yes, second-story additions are possible after a structural engineering review of the existing foundation and framing.

items.title: Interior Remodeling
items.description: A few walls, finishes, or layout changes can completely shift how a home feels. We help remodel interiors so each space feels intentional.
items.detailHeroDesc: A few thoughtful layout and finish changes can completely shift how your home feels day to day.
introParagraphs: Interior remodeling is about the details: trim profiles, lighting layers, flooring transitions, and the small layout changes that make rooms feel right.
We work room by room or across the whole interior, always keeping finishes consistent from space to space.

featured.title: Living Room Makeover
featured.desc: A cozy living room transformed into a spacious entertainment space with modern finishes.

featured.title: Whole-Interior Finish Package
featured.desc: A coordinated finish package brought consistency across every interior room.

faqs.question: Can you remodel just one room at a time?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can remodel a single room or coordinate a full-interior finish package.

faqs.question: Do you offer interior design services?
faqs.answer: Yes, our design team helps coordinate finishes, lighting, and layout before construction begins.

faqs.question: How disruptive is an interior remodel?
faqs.answer: We use dust barriers and phased scheduling to keep disruption to a minimum, especially for occupied homes.

faqs.question: Can you build custom built-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes, our cabinet shop fabricates custom built-ins, shelving, and millwork to your exact space.

items.title: Design & Planning
items.description: Turn your ideas into a practical project plan. We help guide layout, functionality, materials, finishes, and design decisions before construction begins.
items.detailHeroDesc: Turn your ideas into a practical, buildable project plan before construction ever begins.
items.introTitle: A Clear Plan Before You Build
introParagraphs: Good construction starts with good planning. We help you work through layout, functionality, materials, and finish decisions before any wall comes down.
Our design team produces renderings and material boards so you can visualize the finished space and make confident decisions.

featured.title: The Ocala Modern Manor
featured.desc: A full design and planning process guided every material and layout decision on this build.

featured.title: Southern Heritage Estate
featured.desc: Careful upfront planning kept this complex remodel on schedule and on budget.

faqs.question: Do I need architectural drawings before we start?
faqs.answer: For most remodels our in-house design process covers what's needed; larger projects may require a licensed architect, which we can coordinate.

faqs.question: How long does the design phase take?
faqs.answer: Design and planning typically takes 2 to 4 weeks depending on project scope.

faqs.question: Can you help with material selection?
faqs.answer: Yes, our design team curates material and finish options that fit your style and budget.

faqs.question: Will I know the total cost before construction starts?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide a detailed estimate based on the finalized design before construction begins.

items.title: Custom Carpentry
items.description: Add character and detail to your home with custom carpentry, trim work, built-ins, woodwork, doors, and finishing details.
items.detailHeroDesc: Add lasting character with custom carpentry, trim work, built-ins, and hand-finished woodwork.
introParagraphs: Custom carpentry is where character comes from: hand-fit trim, built-in cabinetry, custom doors, and joinery that a pre-fab product can't match.
Our in-house cabinet shop fabricates every piece to the exact dimensions of your space, not the other way around.
introChecklist: Custom trim, casing, and crown molding

featured.title: Hand-Forged Hardware & Finish
featured.desc: Every joint, latch, and beam corner finished by master tradespeople.

featured.title: Custom Built-In Library
featured.desc: Floor-to-ceiling custom built-ins fabricated to the exact dimensions of the room.

faqs.question: Do you build custom furniture pieces?
faqs.answer: We focus on built-in carpentry — cabinetry, shelving, trim, and millwork — fabricated to your home's exact dimensions.

faqs.question: Can you match existing woodwork?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can reproduce or closely match existing trim, door, and cabinetry profiles.

faqs.question: What wood species do you work with?
faqs.answer: We work with oak, pine, cypress, and other hardwoods depending on your style and budget.

faqs.question: Is the cabinet shop in-house?
faqs.answer: Yes, all custom carpentry is fabricated at our own local cabinet shop for a guaranteed fit.

items.title: Exterior Renovations
items.description: We update exterior details, finishes, and features to give the home a stronger, more finished presence from the street.
items.detailHeroDesc: Give your home a stronger presence from the street with updated exterior details and outdoor living features.
items.introTitle: A Stronger Presence From The Street
introParagraphs: Exterior updates make the biggest first impression: masonry, siding, roofing, and outdoor living spaces all shape how a home reads from the street.
We handle everything from brick and stone masonry to covered porches and outdoor entertaining spaces.
introChecklist: Covered porches and outdoor living spaces

featured.title: Roofing & Exterior Refresh
featured.desc: A full exterior update including roofing, siding, and masonry detail.

featured.title: Wrap-Around Brick Porch
featured.desc: A hand-laid brick porch with cypress ceiling extends indoor living outdoors.

faqs.question: Do you handle roofing as part of exterior renovations?
faqs.answer: Yes, roofing, siding, and masonry are all coordinated as part of our exterior renovation scope.

faqs.question: Can you build a covered outdoor living space?
faqs.answer: Yes, we design and build covered porches, patios, and outdoor kitchens to extend your living space outdoors.

faqs.question: How weather-resistant are your exterior materials?
faqs.answer: We select masonry, siding, and roofing materials rated for Central Florida's climate and storm exposure.

faqs.question: Do exterior renovations require permits?
faqs.answer: Most exterior structural and roofing work requires permits, which we manage on your behalf.
